name: Doodle
core_identity: A quick, playful marker doodle on paper, like a drawing in the margin of a notebook. It feels casual, friendly and a little silly, with simple shapes and wobbly lines. Single-weight black marker lines and a few bright accent colours make it recognizable.
medium: Hand-drawn marker doodle on plain paper, black marker lines with a few bright marker accents.
lighting: No real lighting: there is no shading at all, only flat white paper and small coloured scribbles. A lamp or the sun is simply drawn as a circle with little rays.
color_palette: Black marker lines on white paper, with a few bright marker accent colours such as yellow, orange, sky blue and pink, scribbled in loosely. Colour is used sparingly on one or two objects and often goes outside the lines.
camera: The artist's view is a flat, straight-on notebook-page view with everything drawn at the same size and no perspective. Scenes are shown as simple arrangements of objects floating on the page. No depth effects.
composition: A loose, casual layout with the main doodle in the centre, small extra doodles such as stars, hearts and swirls scattered around, and plenty of empty paper. Objects overlap sometimes and are not perfectly aligned.
texture: Wobbly, imperfect, single-weight marker lines with slightly uneven ink, tiny gaps and overshoots, and quick scribbled colour fills with visible stroke direction. Plain white paper with a faint fibre texture.
characters: Simple stick-ish or round-head characters with dot eyes, a simple curve for a smile, line arms and legs and tiny mitten hands. Hair is a few scribbled lines, clothing is a few outline shapes, and elderly characters get a moustache, glasses or a few wrinkle lines. Emotions are shown with simple eyebrow and mouth lines.
negative: realistic shading, photorealism, painting, watercolor, 3D render, CGI look, anime, detailed ink hatching, perfect straight lines, gradients, dark gloomy look, thick brush strokes, text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, distorted hands, deformed face, duplicate people, blurry
motion_rules: Elements wiggle, pop in and bounce, with a boiling-line effect where the outlines shake slightly from frame to frame. Doodles appear one after another as if drawn quickly. Camera is fixed or makes tiny slides. No smooth realistic motion.
style_lock: hand-drawn marker doodle on paper, wobbly single-weight black lines, imperfect simple shapes, a few bright marker accent colours, scribbled colour fills, plain white paper, round-head character, dot eyes, simple smile, casual notebook look, flat no shading, quick playful sketch, faint paper fibre
